lessons.text: Requirement evidence produced by convergence must capture each command’s inputs before execution; aliasing the existing final convergence snapshot can falsely verify a command that modified its inputs.

Native hooks and sandboxed commands can inhabit different PID namespaces; a sandbox-local missing host PID cannot establish native host death. Treat session registration as pending evidence and require actual matched native events for qualification; keep producer release rules separate.
